q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a gold refinery per kilogram?
title: Gold refinery carbon per kg
short: Add the refinery electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25 and any LPG or gas for melting at its default factor, then divide by kilograms refined. That is the refining stage only; the origin of the gold, mined or recycled, is a separate part of the full footprint and must be added from the supplier.
audience: Gold refiners, bullion dealers and jewellery manufacturers

p: Mined gold carries the mining and processing footprint. Recycled gold carries mainly collection and refining. Keep origin evidence, such as refiner declarations, beside the figure.
Only claim recycled content with documents that trace the feed. Mixed feed should be reported as mixed.

example.title: Worked example: refining energy per kg (one month, illustrative inputs)
lines: Total: 15,462 / 450 = 34.4 kg CO2 per kg refined
Mined or recycled origin of the feed changes the full footprint; add it from the supplier
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; this is refining energy only, not the gold's full footprint.
